title: Slash Command Autocomplete Fails with File Reference
body:
**Bug Description**
Typing a slash command and then referencing a file with @ notation doesn't open up the file name autcomplete. For example: /[custom command] @[file name] does not result in opening the file selector dropdown options.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: cursor
- Version: 1.0.43
- Feedback ID: 4f35a664-8ead-4535-83ff-0310e5c4b6a8
author: CaptainCrouton89
